explanation: Candle, Flashlight, Lighthouse, and Spotlight are all objects primarily designed to produce or emit light. A Microphone is used for capturing sound.

Augustus, Nero, Caligula, and Trajan were all officially Roman Emperors, ruling after the end of the Republic. Julius Caesar was a powerful dictator of the Roman Republic whose assassination led to the rise of the Empire, but he never held the title of Emperor himself.
All words except 'Shadow' describe various forms of faint, reflected, or direct light. 'Shadow' describes an area where light is blocked or absent.
